graydient_workflow.author: Graydient Pipeline
graydient_workflow.description: Extend a clip forward: the source tail is preserved pixel-exactly and H3 generates the continuation, then both are assembled with sample-exact audio. Local equivalent of H3 Max Extend.

field_mapping.default_value: Continue the action seamlessly from the preserved opening. Same subject, same wardrobe, same lighting, same lens. Natural continuous motion, no cut.
field_mapping.help_text: Describe what happens AFTER the source clip ends.
Clip to continue. Must be constant 24 fps (loader forces it).
Preserved tail of the source, snapped to 39/90/141/192 frames.
TOTAL timeline length incl. the preserved prefix (17k+5 grid).
Sampling steps. 4 = TaoMate 3-step LoRA + 1; use 8 with strength 0.
TaoMate turbo LoRA strength, applied to model AND clip. 0.0 disables it (then use 8 steps).
Canvas width (multiple of 32). Shared by the H3 node and the reframe pad.
Canvas height (multiple of 32). Shared by the H3 node and the reframe pad.

graydient_workflow.name: minimax-h3-extend-v1
